question: Chemical formula of bleaching powder is ______.
solution:
The correct answer is** CaOCl₂**

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The chemical name of the bleaching powder is calcium hypochlorite.
 
• Bleaching powder is a pale yellowish powder existing with a strong smell of chlorine.
 
• It is soluble in water but due to the presence of impurities, we never observe a clear solution.
